sentences.zh: 你知道，人们应该能够自由地由他们的律师代表。

sentences.en: Judges should be able to make decisions, even if it goes against the president.
sentences.zh: 法官应该能够做出裁决，即使这违背了总统的意愿。

sentences.en: And to see Skadden be complicit to aid this attack, I was so ashamed to work there.
sentences.zh: 看到世达律师事务所（Skadden）竟然同流合污，协助这种攻击，我为在那里工作感到羞耻。

sentences.en: So what did you do?
sentences.zh: 那你做了什么？

sentences.en: So I start actually just writing down notes and really my questions.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始写下笔记，写下我真正的问题。

sentences.en: Some of them are practical, like, how is this going to be enforced?
sentences.zh: 其中一些很实际，比如，这要如何执行？

sentences.en: What will it actually look like?
sentences.zh: 它实际上会是什么样子？

sentences.en: And I started thinking about it and finding answers, and so the questions became statements.
sentences.zh: 我开始思考并寻找答案，于是这些问题变成了陈述。

sentences.en: And then I realized what I had written was a draft of a resignation letter.
sentences.zh: 然后我意识到我写的是一份辞职信草稿。

sentences.en: So that's something there.
sentences.zh: 所以，事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Not necessarily what you set out to do.
sentences.zh: 这未必是你最初打算做的事。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Can I ask you to read from parts of the letter?
sentences.zh: 我可以请你读一下信中的部分内容吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Dear colleagues and friends, I'm writing to let you know that I'm leaving this firm.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的同事和朋友们，我写这封信是想告诉你们，我将离开这家律所。

sentences.en: There was a time when my employment here was so unlikely.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，我能在这里工作是多么不可思议。

sentences.en: For much of my early childhood, I was not a good student.
sentences.zh: 在我童年的大部分时间里，我并不是一个好学生。

sentences.en: I struggled to focus in class and take anything seriously.
sentences.zh: 我很难在课堂上集中注意力，也很难认真对待任何事情。

sentences.en: But even then, there was one subject I loved.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，我还是有一门喜欢的学科。

sentences.en: History.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: I thought it was so wonderful to learn about all that came before me, about the triumphs and tragedies, about the moments of individual bravery and collective complacency.
sentences.zh: 我觉得了解发生在我之前的一切，了解那些胜利与悲剧，了解那些个人勇敢与集体自满的时刻，真是太奇妙了。

sentences.en: I would often imagine myself faced with the same dilemmas.
sentences.zh: 我经常想象自己面临同样的困境。

sentences.en: What would I do if I was there?
sentences.zh: 如果我在那里，我会怎么做？

sentences.en: Would I do the right thing?
sentences.zh: 我会做正确的事吗？

sentences.en: It always felt like there was no way to know.
sentences.zh: 总觉得无从知晓。

sentences.en: I believe, as I know many of you do, that what the current presidential administration is doing is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我相信，正如我知道你们许多人所相信的那样，现任总统政府的做法是错误的。

sentences.en: That we are sliding into an autocracy where those in power are above the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 我们正在滑向独裁，掌权者凌驾于法治之上。

sentences.en: So, Skadden's agreement with the Trump administration sent our country deeper down this dissent.
sentences.zh: 所以，世达与特朗普政府的协议，让我们的国家在异见中越陷越深。

sentences.en: And then I finish, Skadden is on the wrong side of history.
sentences.zh: 最后我写道，世达站在了历史错误的一边。

sentences.en: I can no longer stay knowing that someday I would have to explain why I stayed.
sentences.zh: 我无法再留下来，因为我知道总有一天我必须解释我为什么留下来。

sentences.en: What did it feel like to hit send?
sentences.zh: 点击发送的那一刻是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I mean, listen to your breathing right now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听听你现在的呼吸。

sentences.en: It's like you're reliving it.
sentences.zh: 就像你在重温那一刻一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was it like to send that email?
sentences.zh: 发送那封邮件是什么感觉？

sentences.en: If you heard my breath, it felt like that.
sentences.zh: 如果你听到了我的呼吸声，那就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: Maybe a hundred times more, though.
sentences.zh: 不过可能比那强烈一百倍。

sentences.en: Because I knew that, you know, that was a pivotal moment in my life.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道，那是我人生中的一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: Maybe just as pivotal as coming to the United States in the first place.
sentences.zh: 也许和最初来到美国一样关键。

sentences.en: I knew that I was closing some doors and, you know, a place like Skadden.
sentences.zh: 我知道我正在关闭一些大门，你知道，像世达这样的地方。

sentences.en: And I'm grateful for that experience.
sentences.zh: 我很感激那段经历。

sentences.en: I think it's only possible in a country like the United States.
sentences.zh: 我认为这只有在像美国这样的国家才有可能。

sentences.en: And I really, really believe in it.
sentences.zh: 我真的，真的相信这一点。

sentences.en: I'm sure you're aware that many people who have spoken out against President Trump and his policies have experienced, at times, ferocious blowback.
sentences.zh: 我相信你一定知道，许多公开反对特朗普总统及其政策的人，有时会经历猛烈的反击。

sentences.en: It can be a life-altering event.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一件改变人生的事。

sentences.en: And is that something you're worried about now?
sentences.zh: 你现在担心这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I was finally able to talk to my mother after, you know, resigning.
sentences.zh: 辞职后，我终于能和我母亲谈谈了。

sentences.en: And she's back in Japan, you know, with the rest of my family.
sentences.zh: 她还在日本，和我的其他家人在一起。

sentences.en: And I told her I quit.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她我辞职了。

sentences.en: And she was like, do you have another job?
sentences.zh: 她问我，你有别的工作吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, no, mom, you don't understand.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，妈，你不明白。

sentences.en: Like, this is like in the news.
sentences.zh: 这事儿都上新闻了。

sentences.en: And she sort of didn't process it at firSt.
sentences.zh: 她起初没反应过来。

sentences.en: And then she started to cry.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始哭。

sentences.en: And she asked me to come back to Japan.
sentences.zh: 她让我回日本。

sentences.en: And I said, no, like, I can't.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我不能。

sentences.en: And I won't.
sentences.zh: 我也不会回去。

sentences.en: Many of your colleagues are not leaving their jobs.
sentences.zh: 你的许多同事并没有辞职。

sentences.en: They may feel the way you feel and have two kids they have to put through college.
sentences.zh: 他们可能和你感觉一样，但有两个孩子要供上大学。

sentences.en: They might not feel the way you feel.
sentences.zh: 他们可能并不像你那样想。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about reporting my colleagues did inside the upper echelons of Paul Weiss when that law firm did a deal with Trump.
sentences.zh: 我想到当保罗·韦斯律师事务所（Paul Weiss）与特朗普达成交易时，我的同事在律所高层内部所做的报告。

sentences.en: And it became clear that the majority of the people who run the firm, and lots of them, felt that the best thing to do was to make a deal,
sentences.zh: 很明显，律所的大多数管理者，以及许多人，都认为最好的做法是达成交易，

sentences.en: to protect the thousands of people who work at these firMs.
sentences.zh: 以保护在这些律所工作的成千上万的人。

sentences.en: And that at the end of the day, what they're giving up is small compared to that survival.
sentences.zh: 而且归根结底，他们所放弃的东西与生存相比微不足道。

sentences.en: And the bosses at all these firms that end up capitulating to Trump say some version of, we are the same law firm after we did these deals as we were before.
sentences.zh: 所有这些最终向特朗普妥协的律所老板们，都会说类似的话：我们达成这些交易后，依然是原来的那家律所。

sentences.en: In fact, in a company-wide email, your former boss says just that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在你前老板发给全公司的邮件中，他就是这么说的。

sentences.en: Quote, this agreement does not change who we are.
sentences.zh: 引用：这份协议并没有改变我们是谁。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I just don't think that's true.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得那不是真的。

sentences.en: These law firms are agreeing to these deals when they know that there's no legal basis for any friend executive order.
sentences.zh: 这些律所明知任何行政命令都没有法律依据，却还是同意了这些交易。

sentences.en: And by capitulating, they're aiding, you know, this existential threat against the profession, the independence of the judiciary, and our democracy and everyone who depends on it.
sentences.zh: 通过妥协，他们正在助长这种对职业、司法独立、我们的民主以及所有依赖它的人的生存威胁。

sentences.en: It does change who the firm is.
sentences.zh: 这确实改变了律所的本质。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In short.
sentences.zh: 简而言之。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You very clearly have a lot of faith in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你显然对美国有很强的信念。

sentences.en: But at this point, how confident are you, given everything you've just been through,
sentences.zh: 但事到如今，经历了这一切之后，你有多自信，

sentences.en: that the version of the United States that seems to be at the center of everything you've done here is now the version of the United States?
sentences.zh: 认为那个似乎是你所做一切核心的美国版本，现在依然是那个美国版本？

sentences.en: I'm confident because of what so many people, strangers, you know, reaching out to me, have said to me, which is that they're also scared.
sentences.zh: 我之所以自信，是因为许多人，那些陌生人，你知道，联系我并对我说的话，他们也感到害怕。

sentences.en: Everyone is scared.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很害怕。

sentences.en: But if everyone could, you know, stand up and speak up about this, then we can turn this back.
sentences.zh: 但如果每个人都能，你知道，站出来大声疾呼，那么我们就能扭转局面。

sentences.en: I think we can save it still.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们仍然可以拯救它。

sentences.en: But are you a little bit worried that you're making the wrong bet?
sentences.zh: 但你是否有点担心自己押错了注？

sentences.en: Well, of course I'm, you know, worried, I guess.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然，你知道，我想我是担心的。

sentences.en: You know, I'm putting my career on the line for this, and I knew that going into this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我为此赌上了我的职业生涯，我在做这件事之前就知道了。

sentences.en: I have student loans.
sentences.zh: 我有学生贷款。

sentences.en: I have a single mom who, you know.
sentences.zh: 我有一位单身母亲，你知道。

sentences.en: And you just publicly picked a little bit of a fight with the president.
sentences.zh: 而且你刚刚公开和总统闹了一点矛盾。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I wonder if this experience made you question going into law.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这段经历是否让你质疑当初选择法律这条路。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: I don't regret becoming a lawyer and going to law school.
sentences.zh: 我不后悔成为一名律师并进入法学院学习。

sentences.en: It's a wonderful education.
sentences.zh: 这是一次美妙的教育。

sentences.en: You know, even my time at Skadden, I learned so much.
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使在世达的那段时间，我也学到了很多。

sentences.en: And it's equipping me with skills, I think, to advocate for what I believe in and for others as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为它赋予了我技能，让我能够为我的信仰以及为他人辩护。

sentences.en: And that's what lawyers do.
sentences.zh: 这就是律师所做的事情。

sentences.en: Well, Thomas, thank you for coming in here and for telling us this story.
sentences.zh: 好的，托马斯，谢谢你来到这里并告诉我们这个故事。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: After the break, how Thomas has fared since he quit his job.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，托马斯辞职后的境况如何。

sentences.en: Let's catch up.
sentences.zh: 让我们来叙叙旧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Formally.
sentences.zh: 正式一点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You look well.
sentences.zh: 你看上去不错。

sentences.en: You look rested.
sentences.zh: 你看上去休息得很好。

sentences.en: The last time you saw me, I was running on almost no sleep.
sentences.zh: 上次你见到我时，我几乎没怎么睡觉。

sentences.en: Well, catch me up on everything that's happened to you.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我说说你身上发生的一切吧。

sentences.en: Last time we spoke, it was just a few days after you quit your job at Skadden.
sentences.zh: 我们上次交谈时，距离你从世达辞职才过去几天。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Suddenly, you're not employed.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你失业了。

sentences.en: You're not getting any paychecks.
sentences.zh: 你没有了收入。

sentences.en: What happened next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: I came on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我上了这个播客。

sentences.en: I remember that part.
sentences.zh: 我记得那部分。

sentences.en: And it sounded like people generally liked, you know, what I said.
sentences.zh: 听起来人们普遍喜欢，你知道，我所说的话。

sentences.en: And I got so many heartfelt messages from people, you know, feeling that sort of hopefulness that I feel, thinking about these sort of democratic values,
sentences.zh: 我收到了许多人发来的感人至深的信息，你知道，他们感受到了我所感受到的那种希望，思考着这些民主价值观，

sentences.en: what I mean to be an American.
sentences.zh: 我所理解的美国人意味着什么。

sentences.en: Other people reached out because they felt sort of maybe a kinship, a sort of common background, whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 其他人联系我，是因为他们感到了一种亲近感，一种共同的背景，无论那是什么。

sentences.en: Maybe there were just some parents who were worried about their kids and, you know, listening with their kids.
sentences.zh: 也许还有一些父母担心他们的孩子，你知道，和他们的孩子一起听。

sentences.en: And those are some of the most touching ones.
sentences.zh: 那些是最感人的信息之一。

sentences.en: There was one in particular that really struck me.
sentences.zh: 有一个特别让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: Can you describe it?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: It was a father driving his kids to school.
sentences.zh: 那是一位父亲开车送孩子上学。

sentences.en: And they're listening to this episode.
sentences.zh: 他们正在听这一集。

sentences.en: And he's asking his kids, what would you do?
sentences.zh: 他问他的孩子们，你们会怎么做？

sentences.en: If you were in Thomas's position?
sentences.zh: 如果你处在托马斯的位置？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，正是如此。

sentences.en: And that's the sort of thing that when I was a kid, I would think about in history class.
sentences.zh: 那是我小时候在历史课上会思考的那种事情。

sentences.en: And I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It was a really great feeling.
sentences.zh: 那是一种非常棒的感觉。

sentences.en: And it gave me a real, it was like a win in my back.
sentences.zh: 它给了我一种真正的，就像背后有风助我一臂之力。

sentences.en: And what ends up happening to your job prospects?
sentences.zh: 你的就业前景最后怎么样了？

sentences.en: Do you end up finding a job?
sentences.zh: 你最后找到工作了吗？

sentences.en: Long story short, I do.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，我找到了。

sentences.en: I'm currently working for a federal judge.
sentences.zh: 我目前在为一位联邦法官工作。

sentences.en: And what can you tell me about that work, how you got it, and how it may or may not fit into the way that your last job ended?
sentences.zh: 关于那份工作，你是怎么得到的，以及它是否符合你上一份工作结束的方式，你能告诉我些什么吗？

sentences.en: I can't tell you a lot, but I can tell you some things.
sentences.zh: 我不能告诉你太多，但我可以告诉你一些事情。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The judge actually found me through his network and mine kind of colliding.
sentences.zh: 法官实际上是通过他的关系网和我的关系网碰撞在一起才找到我的。

sentences.en: I'm his, the title is I'm a law clerk.
sentences.zh: 我是他的，头衔是我是一名法律助理。

sentences.en: And the job is essentially analyzing the law, explaining it, making recommendations to the judge.
sentences.zh: 这份工作本质上是分析法律，解释法律，并向法官提出建议。

sentences.en: So you're basically the judge's assistant.
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上是法官的助手。

sentences.en: I know when you clerk for a judge, this is my sense, you may not be able to discuss a lot of the intricacies of your work.
sentences.zh: 我知道当你为法官做书记员时，这是我的理解，你可能无法讨论工作的很多细节。

sentences.en: But it strikes me that if you're working for a federal judge, you're potentially interacting with President Trump's agenda to some degree.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，如果你在为联邦法官工作，你可能在某种程度上与特朗普总统的议程有交集。

sentences.en: And federal judges are the figures in our legal system right now who are seen as really the most powerful and important potential checks on this president.
sentences.zh: 在我们的法律体系中，联邦法官目前被视为对这位总统最强大、最重要的潜在制衡力量。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that hasn't escaped you either.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一点你也注意到了。

sentences.en: I'm, to be honest, I'm not going to talk about, you know, active cases that may or may not be before my judge.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不会谈论那些可能正在或可能不在我法官审理范围内的在审案件。

sentences.en: It's because there's pretty serious ethics concerns about, you know, clerks typically don't talk to the media.
sentences.zh: 这是因为存在非常严重的职业道德顾虑，毕竟书记员通常是不会接受媒体采访的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I want to make it clear that the judge's job isn't to be a partisan actor.
sentences.zh: 我想明确一点，法官的工作不是充当党派参与者。

sentences.en: It's to be the adjudicator of what the law says.
sentences.zh: 而是作为法律条文的裁决者。

sentences.en: And as, you know, my judge's clerk, that's also my job and responsibility.
sentences.zh: 作为我法官的书记员，这也是我的工作和职责所在。

sentences.en: And I take that really seriously.
sentences.zh: 我对此非常认真。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think the true interpretation is that, you know, I made this decision on ethics grounds.
sentences.zh: 我认为真正的解读是，我是在职业道德的基础上做出的这个决定。

sentences.en: And it was about what I thought, you know, the law was, what the Constitution demands.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我心目中法律的定义，以及宪法的要求。

sentences.en: And I was just hoping to explain my own decision in a time when I think a lot of people were facing a similar decision.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望能解释我自己的决定，因为当时我认为很多人都面临着类似的抉择。

sentences.en: And they weren't sure what it would look like on the other side.
sentences.zh: 他们不确定做出决定后会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And I guess right now I'm speaking to you from the other side of that decision.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在正站在那个决定的另一端与你对话。

sentences.en: Say, I was fine.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我很好。

sentences.en: I was actually more than fine.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我过得比好还要好。

sentences.en: There is another side.
sentences.zh: 生活还有另一面。

sentences.en: There is another side.
sentences.zh: 生活还有另一面。

sentences.en: To quitting a big, prestigious, well-paying job at a law firm on principle.
sentences.zh: 为了原则而辞去律师事务所那份薪水丰厚、地位显赫的工作。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And in the year 2025, you'll end up all right.
sentences.zh: 到了2025年，你会发现一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: And specifically speaking to the lawyers, not everyone in America can safely speak their mind right now.
sentences.zh: 特别对律师们说一句，现在并不是美国每个人都能安全地表达自己的想法。

sentences.en: But lawyers can.
sentences.zh: 但律师可以。

sentences.en: Obviously, you may be targeted.
sentences.zh: 当然，你可能会成为目标。

sentences.en: But the law firms that fought back and are winning in courts are doing fine financially.
sentences.zh: 但那些奋起反抗并在法庭上获胜的律师事务所，在财务上依然经营得很好。

sentences.en: They're not going underwater.
sentences.zh: 它们不会倒闭。

sentences.en: And this, I think, existential fear was completely overblown.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种生存恐惧被完全夸大了。

sentences.en: It was overstated.
sentences.zh: 被言过其实了。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: It's an excuse.
sentences.zh: 这只是个借口。

sentences.en: I think it was putting profits over an oath that lawyers swear to protect the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是将利润置于律师保护宪法的誓言之上。

sentences.en: And, you know, if someone like me ends up fine, more than fine, then the executive partners and chairpersons of these law firMs...
sentences.zh: 而且，如果像我这样的人最终能过得很好，甚至比以前更好，那么这些律师事务所的执行合伙人和主席们……

sentences.en: Who make many millions more.
sentences.zh: 他们赚的钱要多得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Would have been completely fine, too.
sentences.zh: 他们也完全可以过得很好。

sentences.en: And regardless, I think the oaths have to mean something.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我认为誓言必须是有意义的。

sentences.en: Thank you once again for your time and your candor.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你抽出时间并坦诚相待。

sentences.en: The pleasure and the privilege is all mine.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: I really just want to say thank you because you're a huge part of what happened to me a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 我真的只想说声谢谢，因为你是几个月前发生在我身上那件事的重要推手。

sentences.en: You changed my life.
sentences.zh: 你改变了我的人生。

sentences.en: Oh, well, you changed your own life.
sentences.zh: 噢，其实是你自己改变了你的人生。

sentences.en: We just chronicled it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是记录了这一切。

sentences.en: Today's Daily was produced by Olivia Nett, Shannon Lynn, and Muj Zady.
sentences.zh: 今天的《每日新闻》由奥利维亚·内特、香农·林恩和穆吉·扎迪制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willans, Jody Becker, and Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 由帕特里夏·威廉斯、朱迪·贝克和迈克尔·贝努瓦编辑。

sentences.en: Contains music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley, Rowan Amisto, and Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利、罗文·阿米斯托和克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Jessica Silver-Greenberg.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢杰西卡·西尔弗-格林伯格。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或任何您喜欢的播客平台找到《Wirecutter秀》。
